paragraphs: Incorporated on September 29, 2005, Monomark Engineering (India) Limited is engaged in providing Industrial Operations and Maintenance (“O&M”) services, Metal Fabrication solutions and Industrial Project Execution services to industrial clients across sectors such as metals, cement, ports and engineering/OEMs. The Company’s business is organised into three segments: Industrial O&M Services, Metal Fabrication Solutions and Industrial Project Execution Services. Its O&M services include production support, plant operations, preventive and breakdown maintenance, equipment monitoring and technical support. Its metal fabrication activities involve manufacturing customised sheet metal components and structural products based on client specifications and engineering drawings. Under its project execution segment, the Company undertakes engineering, procurement and construction (“EPC”) contracts, as well as on-site fabrication, erection, installation and commissioning (“FEIC”) assignments involving heavy machinery, piping, structural steel and industrial equipment.

The Company operates a dedicated metal fabrication facility at Kapasan, Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, with an annual installed capacity of 4,000 MT. Its execution capabilities are supported by an in-house fleet of 232 industrial vehicles and equipment, including forklifts, trucks, excavators, cranes, hydra machines, bulldozers and loaders. This equipment base, together with its technical workforce, enables the Company to manage site-level logistics, mobilise resources and execute operational and project-related activities across multiple locations.

The Company serves industrial clients across the metals, ports, cement and engineering/OEM sectors, with an established client base that includes Vedanta Group, Adani Group, Aditya Birla Group, L&T Group, Tata Group, JK Lakshmi Cement Group and Shree Cement Group. It operates across seven Indian states and has an overseas subsidiary, Monomark Engineering FZE, in the United Arab Emirates, through which it provides O&M services to Fujairah Gold FZC.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 28 ongoing projects, comprising 21 O&M projects and 7 Industrial Project Execution projects. It reported a running unexecuted order book of ₹1,76,192.16 lakh as of the same date.
As of September 30, 2026, the Company had a total workforce of 7,608 employees, comprising 958 fixed employees and 6,650 project-specific employees.

faqs.question: How to apply in Monomark Engineering (India) IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Monomark Engineering (India) IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Monomark Engineering (India) IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Monomark Engineering (India) IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .
